outcome: A creature spell with mutate can be cast for its mutate cost, in which case it targets a non-Human creature with the same owner.
A mutating creature spell whose target is illegal as it begins resolving resolves as a creature spell and enters the battlefield under its controller.
A mutating creature spell with a legal target merges with it instead of entering the battlefield, forming one mutated permanent.
A "whenever a creature mutates" ability triggers when a spell merges with a creature on resolution.
A mutated permanent has the abilities of all its cards and tokens and its other characteristics from the topmost one.
An effect that modifies the mutating creature spell modifies the mutated permanent it merges with.
